auth.description: Authentication configuration for OAuth providers and session management

loginEndpoint.description: Server endpoint for all login/session operations

sessionCheck.description: Check existing session — send with no extra params
sessionCheck.notes: Response also includes provider preferences (prio/hide) so app can apply them immediately on login.

providers.description: Google OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with server redirect
Facebook Login via Facebook JS SDK
Microsoft MSAL.js redirect flow (popup blocked by COOP headers)
providers.notes: Uses sessionStorage for MSAL cache. Requires clearMsalState() on logout to prevent stale authority errors.

providers.description: Discord OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with server redirect

api.description: API configuration for all data endpoints. GET endpoints return JSON files. POST endpoints send form data to the postEndpoint.

browse.description: Browse titles by type and optional genre with pagination

title.description: Full title detail — metadata, cast, videos, watch providers, reviews

providerList.description: List of all streaming providers with metadata

providerTitles.description: Browse titles available on a specific streaming provider

prodCompany.description: Browse titles from a specific production company

search.description: Search titles and artists by query

tag.description: Get, set, or remove user interaction tags on a title
tag.notes: do:get returns all tags for a title (no tag param needed). vote tag requires extra 'vote' param. star tag requires extra 'star' param.

review.description: Get, submit, or delete a user review for a title
review.notes: content param required for do:put, ignored for get/del

copyitems.description: Copy items from a source list

emptylist.description: Remove all items from a list

delitem.description: Remove a title from a list

viewlist.description: View a public shared list by hash

provpref.description: Get or set user streaming provider preferences
provpref.notes: do:get returns all prefs as {source: status} map. prio = prioritize provider, hide = hide provider. del resets to default (show). Profile page resyncs prefs via do:get each time the providers tab loads.

titlefreewatch.description: Get free watch URLs for a title

title_reviews.description: Get all reviews for a title

profile.description: Get or manage user profile and tagged title lists

seenlist.description: Get titles on user's seen list (paginated)

rated.description: Get titles user has voted on (paginated)
rated.notes: tag_data contains vote direction (up/down). star_rating is a separate numeric field (1-5) if user has star-rated the title.

reviews.notes: Items have a nested title object. content is the review text. tima is the review timestamp.

del.description: Remove a title from a user list (watchlist, seenlist, or rated)
del.notes: Removes the corresponding tag from the title. Account deletion is handled via the /delete page form, not this endpoint.

content.description: Content metadata — types, genres, image config, and streaming provider catalog

providers.label: Best of British Television on Prime

pages.description: SPA route patterns. {id} is numeric, {slug} is URL-friendly name, {type} maps to content.types keys, {source} maps to provider source keys.
pages.title: /title/{id}-{slug}
pages.notes: Browse and provider pages support genre filtering via URL hash fragment (e.g. /free#Action). List hash is a hex string identifier for shared lists.

navigation.description: Main navigation bar items and profile page tab sections
navigation.notes: profileSections order matches tab display order. Each maps to a profile sub-page rendered by ProfilePage.

tagging.description: User interaction tags on titles (like, dislike, watchlist, seen, star rating, share)

platforms.notes: Opens native mail client, no popup

providerPreferences.description: User streaming provider priority and visibility settings
providerPreferences.notes: prio = prioritize (show first), hide = hidden from results. Default state is show (no preference stored).
